credits.title: The Life After Death Project 2: Personal Encounters
credits.overview: Spellbinding accounts of personal encounters with life after death from people of all walks of life including doctors and nurses who have seen spirit visitations and related strange phenomena. Also updates the Forrest J Ackerman case.

credits.title: The Life After Death Project
credits.overview: A fascinating quest for proof of life after death -- a true-life enigma that begins with one small, odd incident and mushrooms into a huge scientific inquiry into apparent messages from the 'Other Side.'

credits.title: Dan Aykroyd Unplugged On UFOs
credits.overview: A UFO enthusiast interviews Dan Aykroyd on the subject of extraterrestrials visiting Earth.

credits.title: The Phoenix Lights...We Are Not Alone
credits.overview: During the evening of March 13, 1997, a mile-wide, V-shaped formation of lights (that seemed to be attached to something) slowly and silently traversed throughout Arizona at a very low altitude for many hours. The inexplicable and awesome event was witnessed by thousands of people, while they were looking up at the sky

credits.title: Raising Arizona
credits.overview: When a childless couple—an ex-con and an ex-cop—take one of a wealthy family’s quintuplets to raise as their own, their lives grow more complicated than anticipated.
